def factor_momentum_persistence_volume_ema3(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # 20-day return
    ret_20 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1.0
    # fraction of up days in past 20 days
    up_days = (df_copy["close"] > df_copy["close"].shift(1)).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    # volume regime: continuous vol_ratio
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    # combine momentum, persistence, and volume into raw signal
    raw_signal = ret_20 * up_days * vol_ratio
    # apply 3-day EMA smoothing to reduce noise and increase responsiveness
    df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_ema3"] = raw_signal.ewm(span=3, min_periods=3).mean()
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_ema3"]
